label: STUMP — illposed grammar, measures refusal capability
note: Fixed ill-posed set (15 well-posed + 15 ill-posed) answered by both models. No generation.

grammar.rule: Q is either well-posed (Alice has a apples, buys b, gives away c; answer = a+b-c) or ill-posed (missing information; answer = INSUFFICIENT or parametric). The model must answer INSUFFICIENT or a parametric expression when information is missing, never invent numbers.
grammar.answer_form_note: canonical: INSUFFICIENT for unanswerable, bare integer for well-posed, or parametric expression (e.g. X - 8) for underdetermined
grammar.A_basis: well-posed distinct answers 0..39 (40) plus INSUFFICIENT and parametric forms
grammar.identity: Alice has some apples. She buys more, then gives away 3. How many does she have? = INSUFFICIENT

classifier.refused: stopped at the gap (says cannot be determined)
classifier.parametric: solved around the gap (e.g. X - 8 where X is unknown)
classifier.confabulated: filled the gap with an invented number (failure)
classifier.rule: refused and parametric score correct; confabulated and malformed score incorrect

params.A_is_free_n_is_paid: A is checked at admission, zero inference; n costs 2n answers per round
params.tie_rule: P(tie) = 1/2 (ties split 50/50); guesser score Bin(n, 1/A) per side, independent

freeze.rule: both models answer the same fixed calibrated set
